parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for requests and responses. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The action mode of the rule. Valid values:
- **1**: Alert.
- **2**: Block.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The rule ID.
> You can call the [ListSasContainerWebDefenseRule](~~2623606~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The rule type. Valid values:
- **0**: User-defined.
- **1**: System built-in.
